title: I Think I'm OKAY
lyrics:
[00:08.12] Watch me, take a good thing and fuck it all up in one night
[00:12.11] Catch me, I'm the one on the run away from the headlights
[00:16.03] No sleep, up all week wasting time with people I don't like
[00:20.01] I think something's fucking wrong with me
[00:24.00] Drown myself in alcohol, that shit never helps at all
[00:27.78] I might say some stupid things tonight when you pick up this call
[00:31.72] I've been hearing silence on the other side for way too long
[00:35.80] I can taste it on my tongue, I can tell that something's wrong but
[00:40.09] I guess it's just my life and I can take it if I wanna
[00:44.20] But I cannot hide in hills of California
[00:47.97] Because these hills have eyes, and I got paranoia
[00:51.67] I hurt myself sometimes, is that too scary for you?
[00:56.26] Watch me, take a good thing and fuck it all up in one night
[01:00.04] Catch me, I'm the one on the run away from the headlights
[01:04.07] No sleep, up all week wasting time with people I don't like
[01:08.08] I think that something's fucking wrong with me
[01:12.02] Roll me up and smoke me, love
[01:16.28] And we can fly into the night
[01:20.60] Roll me up and smoke me, love
[01:24.20] And we can fly into the night
[01:28.21] You take drugs (take drugs) to let go (let go)
[01:32.79] And figure it all out on your own
[01:36.11] Take drugs (take drugs) on gravestones (gravestones)
[01:40.84] To figure it all out on your own
[01:44.20] Watch me take a good thing and fuck it all up in one night
[01:48.09] Catch me, I'm the one on the run away from the headlights
[01:52.03] No sleep, up all week wasting time with people I don't like
[01:56.06] I think that something's fucking wrong with me
[01:59.79] You'll find me alone at midnight
[02:03.59] Inside my mind, tryna get things right (something's fucking wrong with me)
[02:07.77] They want to keep you calling
[02:11.64] So you don't wake in the morning (something's fucking wrong with me)
[02:15.12] Goodnight, goodnight
[02:23.16] Goodnight, goodnight, yeah
[02:31.40] Find me alone at midnight (goodnight)
[02:35.09] Inside my mind, tryna get things right (goodnight)
[02:39.68] They want to keep you calling (goodnight)
[02:43.44] So you don't wake in the morning (goodnight)
